correctness.rationale: Every maximal matching has a unique admissible nine-state encoding. The rail-twist matrix S produces the exact trace tr(T^n S), and its commuting +/- eigenspace decomposition has exact verified determinants Q+ and Q-. A formal Laurent-to-power-series transformation proves the strict lower bound; explicit Taylor coefficient extraction proves every minimum multiplicity with the n=3 exception. The attached verifier recomputes determinants from actual state definitions and brute-forces all cardinalities for n=3..10; those finite tests supplement the all-order proof.

value.rationale: The saturation number and distribution of inclusion-maximal matchings are natural invariants tied to edge domination and optimization quality; an ungraded total cannot answer either question. This exact all-order result identifies a structural twisted boundary obstruction at n divisible by 3 and gives counts for each achievable size, including residue-class counts of minimizers. This is a meaningful exact classification of an established nonplanar cubic graph family, not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere restatement of a scalar recurrence.
